title: Manhattan plot as a named display of −log10 p
dek: Wikipedia genetics plot: genomic position versus −log10 p. It is a display, not a likelihood and not a causal map.
story: A Manhattan plot on Wikipedia is a scatter of −log10 p against genomic coordinate, classically looking like a skyline. It is a display of many tests. It is not the GLM, not the kinship, not the FDR contract.
Peaks are LD blocks (or clonal tags in bacteria), not automatically causal nucleotides. Fine-mapping is extra work.
Q–Q plots of the same p-values ask whether the bulk looks like Uniform(0,1). Different display, same tests (wiki-qq).
deep: Truncating the y-axis to hide a pile of small p-values is a rhetorical move.
Colour by chromosome is convention, not biology.
A pretty skyline with λ_GC=1.4 is still a bulk-null problem.
Do not put a Manhattan in a paper without naming the test and the covariates.

visual.caption: Teaching bars: a skyline is −log10 p, not β, not a posterior, not a tree. Three misreadings.
